description: This file defines an abstract class SuiteEditorSettings for managing editor settings in SuiteCRM, including properties like content, textarea ID, element ID, width, group, and click handler, along with methods for construction and extension of settings.

classes.name: SuiteEditorSettings
classes.description: An abstract class that handles the settings for editors in SuiteCRM, allowing extension and initialization of various editor configuration parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for SuiteEditorSettings that optionally extends the object with provided settings.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Method to extend the current settings with a provided array or object of key-value pairs.
